messages:
pagerbot: SEV1 - sharp increase in 5xx for Private VPC routes that fan out ILB -> cross-region (us-east1 -> europe-west1). Auto-page infra oncall.

tom: oncall here, ack. pulling ILB counters and recent control-plane events.

nina: forwarding rules show high UNKNOWN_ROUTE errors and packet drops on ilb-fanout-eu. backends are healthy at app layer. snippet: ```
forwardingRule: ilb-fanout-eu: drops=12177, errors=UNKNOWN_ROUTE, pkts=19733
backend_health: ok (all backends report SERVING)
```

rachel: traced a failed request from a Private VPC in us-east1 to a model endpoint in europe-west1 — TLS completes then HTTP/2 reset, upstream reports RST_STREAM. tcpdump shows RST originating in the ILB host.

sam_cs: CS flagged three paying customers with pins to EU models (secure data customers). opening outreach now.

pagerbot: Incident logged: INC-2028-05-11-07 severity SEV1. page: tom -> rotation.

tom: mitigation options: 1) force-control-plane re-publish for affected ILB entries 2) temporarily steer tenants to same-region model variants 3) hosted fallback for tenants who accept it 4) create regional proxy (last resort). Prioritize minimal data movement.

nina: attempting republish: ```
POST /internal/controlplane/ilb/republish?region=europe-west1&force=true
```
republish returned 202 but counters unchanged after 5m.

gcp-support-bot: Case 2468101214 created with GCP. Initial triage: "suspected replication lag within ILB forwarding table updater for cross-region forwarding entries; engineers investigating." Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2468101214 (internal)

datadog-bot: Heads up: Datadog metrics pipeline reporting backlog for LB metrics ~4-7m. some graphs may be delayed.

rachel: because Datadog lag, our alerted thresholds fired late. recommend we add a synthetic that directly probes ILB forwarding results from a Private VPC.

sam_cs: enterprise-a and secure-bank are impacted. enterprise-a agreed to temporary regional pin to eu-west1; secure-bank requires legal approval before any hosted fallback. pinging legal.

legal-bot: Legal reviewing ephemeral processing waiver for hosted fallback (secure-bank). ETA ~25m.

nina: republish attempt #2 with region-scoped rollback sequence: ```
POST /internal/controlplane/ilb/republish
{"region":"europe-west1","sequence_hint":"force-rollup"}
```
This time forwarding drops decreased marginally. partial recovery for some entries.

tom: start tenant reroutes for enterprise-a and dev-sandboxes to eu-local variants. command: ```
PATCH /v1/tenants/enterprise-a/routing
{"preferred_region":"eu-west1-local"}
```
enterprise-a traffic now 200/ok.

sam_cs: secure-bank signed waiver for hosted fallback (6h). proceeding with cutover.

nina: initiating hosted fallback cutover for secure-bank with gradual ramp and traffic shadowing: ```
POST /internal/fallbacks/cutover
{"tenant":"secure-bank","target":"hosted-eu","ramp_seconds":300}
```
cutover in progress. monitoring.

rachel: after cutover, secure-bank traffic shows 200s from hosted-eu. overall Private VPC 5xx rate drops back to baseline.

gcp-support-bot: Update: fix deployed to control plane for europe-west1 ILB replication. Engineers continuing to monitor propagation; expect full convergence in ~10-20m.

datadog-bot: Backfill complete for LB metrics. graphs updated.

tom: verify: running cross-region synthetic sweep — success rates restored for previously failing paths. manual checks from affected Private VPCs return 200.

pagerbot: Incident INC-2028-05-11-07 severity degraded to SEV2 (partial impact mitigated).

tom: handing to night oncall @oncall-next. Notes for next oncall: GCP confirmed control-plane replication regression; most tenants rerouted or moved to hosted fallback; one hosted fallback required legal waiver. We used republish + routing pinning + hosted fallback in that order. Observability lag from Datadog delayed alerting ~5m.

oncall-next: acked. I will watch for regression and collect logs. Please drop runbook steps and artifacts here.

rachel: artifacts uploaded: https://drive.internal/incidents/INC-2028-05-11-07 (routing snapshots, tcpdumps, control-plane traces).

tom: post-incident action items:
- request GCP RCA and proof that ILB control-plane replication fix addresses cross-region fanout entries
- add a targeted synthetic that validates ILB forwarding table propagation across regions from a Private VPC vantage point
- add a documented CS/Legal playbook for hosted fallback waiver (template)
- consider a secondary metrics path for critical LB counters (investigate Datadog SLA + backup stream)
- update runbook with explicit republish command and when to escalate to regional proxy/NAT approach

pagerbot: Incident INC-2028-05-11-07 marked MITIGATED. Please file postmortem and tag owners: tom, nina, rachel, sam_cs.

sam_cs: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and summary notes once GCP RCA available.

oncall-next: will collect postmortem notes and schedule within 72h. closing active pager but leaving channel open for follow-ups.
